feeds.title: The Mom Edit
feeds.description: Founded in 2008 by me, Shana Draugelis, The Mom Edit is a fashion & lifestyle blog. My goal is to elevate the practical, everyday mom-uniform into something that inspires - moms or no.

feeds.title: Hey Trina
feeds.description: Wife, mom, and fashion-obsessed shopaholic, Trina, knows that being fab has no starting age.HeyTrina.com chronicles all of Trina's adventures in fashion with her daughters in tow. As a top Atlanta Mom Fashion Blogger, Trina has partnered with Neiman Marcus, Johnson Johnson, Verizon, Pandora, McDonald's, Carter's, and more.

feeds.title: Mom Style Lab
feeds.description: Mom Style Lab was created by a mom who loves fashion FOR moms or simply aspire to look their best. Created by Angela Keller, mom to eight-year-old Christina, MSL is designed to help identify looks that work for women and their lifestyle, streamline the shopping experience, and provide tips and tricks on how to dress best for you.

feeds.title: The Everymom » Mom Fashion
feeds.description: Features articles that have to do exclusively with Mom Fashion, Shopping, and Beauty. 'The Everymom' is a space where stylish mothers of all ages can come to seek guidance on motherhood, parenting, and kids.

feeds.title: Hello Fashion Blog
feeds.description: This blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Fashion Markerting. I'm Christine Andrew, I started this online diary as a way to share my favorite sales, buys and fashion finds. Now I share everything from family and travel to fashion, beauty, and home decor.

feeds.title: The Motherchic
feeds.description: I'm a Philly native who married her high school sweetheart and the second oldest daughter of 5 girls. Here you'll get real mom reflections on parenting and simple ways to update the mom uniform with accessible, affordable fashion trends.

feeds.title: 9to5Chic
feeds.description: I am Anh, wife of an OCD cutie, and mother to a little girl named Lucia.9to5Chic. This is my way of expressing my personal style at work. But it wouldn't be a personal style diary unless I shared some fun weekend outfits when I'm off the clock too.

feeds.title: Andee Layne
feeds.description: Hi loves, welcome to The Honeybee! I'm Andee Layne, wife to my anti-Instagram husband Stephen and mom to my two little crazies (Ava & Luca). This is my creative space to share all things fab and snippets of our life in the beautiful Orange County. Thanks so much for stopping by!

feeds.title: The stylish housewife
feeds.description: Wife, mom and blogger behind The Stylish Housewife. Addicted to fashion, shopping, nail polish and anti-aging products...in no particular order.

feeds.title: I Am Style-ish
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Tiffany and I live in Seattle with my husband and our two girls. As a small business owner and mom, I hope to inspire you here with my everyday fashion finds, how to decorate your home and how to live your best life as a busy mom!

feeds.title: AMOTHERSEDIT
feeds.description: AMOTHERSEDIT is written by Ashley, a thirty two year old mother of two. Rediscovering my passion for fashion has been so much fun and the Instagram community is incredible when you're looking for inspiration and support. I love black & white, lace & denim and have a magpie eye for anything shiny or gold. I hope I can help inspire a few others on my mum-style journey.

feeds.title: Mommy in Flats
feeds.description: I'm Jamie, the youngest of five, mother to four, and wife to one, I am Stay at Home Mommy fashion blogger I created Mommy in Flats as a side project to channel my love of fashion and writing but it has become so much more.

feeds.title: The Rachel Parcell Blog
feeds.description: We're a creative, fashion, and lifestyle brand founded in 2016. Rachel herself is our CEO and Creative Director -devoted mom, wife, sister, designer, and blogger of all things pink, pretty, and RP-approved. Through her namesake collections, creative content, and personalized brand partnerships, Rachel curates chic and romantic inspiration for your wardrobe, celebrations, travel, home décor, and individual style.

feeds.title: The Chriselle Factor
feeds.description: The mission of The Chriselle Factor is Making the world pretty, one Girl At a time. Stylist and Digital Influencer, Chriselle Lim has been creating quite a stir in the fashion industry. Her goal is to encourage, educate, and inspire all women across the globe through her personal style, runway trends, beauty secrets, and fashion tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Get Your Pretty On Blog
feeds.description: Everyday Style and Beauty Inspiration for Real Women. Every woman deserves to feel pretty get the scoop on the latest fashion and beauty trends plus easy style tips so you look and feel pretty every day!

feeds.title: Lauren McBride Blog
feeds.description: A Connecticut Based Life and Style Blog. Featuring style, beauty, home decor, and motherhood. Lauren McBride is the author and hopes to encourage and inspire other women in the vicinity.

feeds.title: Mattie James
feeds.description: Stylish mama Mattie James encapsulates everything awesome about cool moms. Queen of the '70s style jumpsuit and mother of one adorable little girl, mama Mattie exposes all of her best fashion secrets and keeps her readers looking good on her blog Mattieologie

feeds.title: Lux Mommy Blog
feeds.description: My name is Amanda, and I am currently living in Houston, TX with my family. I've lived in Texas my whole life. I am originally from a small beach community, but moved to Houston to attend University of Houston and have been here ever since. Growing up it was clear that I had an eye for fashion which only grew over time. It was finally time for me to create an outlet for that passion, and LuxMommy was born.

feeds.title: Ramshackle Glam
feeds.description: I am Jordan Reid. I created Ramshackle Glam to follow my experiments in the spheres of fashion, beauty, entertaining, and home décor. In the years since, Ramshackle Glam has been featured in publications including Time Magazine, Cosmopolitan, the New York Observer, The Huffington Post, and Lonny.

feeds.title: Style Pantry
feeds.description: Style Pantry is your fashion and lifestyle stockist. A network that features interviews on industry folks, street style, lookbooks, campaigns and haute finds. Folake Kuye Huntoon regularly updates her daily looks as a working mother of 3, sharing tips and secrets on where/how to shop bargains and find vintage treasures.

feeds.title: Haute & Humid
feeds.description: Haute and Humid is a fashion and lifestyle blog with a spotlight on making your everyday life effortless, attainable and fun. Hi! I'm Sara and welcome to Haute and Humid. I am a wife and mom of two, residing in the great state of Texas.

feeds.title: THEFASHIONGUITAR
feeds.description: It was only after working with several fashion blogs in her former job, Charlotte realized she wanted to start her own. This is one of the best fashion blogs for women by charlotte which is completely based on quality of real factors. Charlotte made this blog by truly inspiration of fashion to become master in ways to find perfect dress, wedding shoes and many more.

feeds.title: good life
feeds.description: A personal style blog featuring simple and casual style for moms and women in western michigan. good life is written by Jill Gott-Gleason, a mother and fashionista that believes that style should be fun, affordable and never boring.

feeds.title: Amy Davidson
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Amy Davidson. With this site, I plan on sharing everything from the newest nail polish color (ladies you know how extremely important this is to my favorite type of baby bottle, to stories of triumphs and failures and beyond. I will be blogging, sharing pictures and experiences, and creating a platform for all of you to interact as well.

feeds.title: The Mom in Style Blog
feeds.description: Follow The Mom in Style blog, where modern motherhood meets fashion-forward living. Founded by Sarah Johnson, a mom, fashion enthusiast, and lifestyle blogger, this space is all about embracing personal style while navigating the joys and challenges of raising a family. Join Sarah as she shares relatable anecdotes, styling tips, and product reviews, making fashion meet function in the everyday life of a modern mom.

feeds.title: Mama In Heels
feeds.description: Mama In Heels is created as a platform to provide style inspiration, shopping tips, fashion, healthy eating, and much more.

feeds.title: The London Mummy
feeds.description: The London Mummy is is an online lifestyle destination, run by Lucinda Robins, a mother of 3 age 7, 5 and 3. It is for women who want a summary of the latest fashion, styles & events but who don't have time to research themselves.

feeds.title: Rage Against The Mom Jean Blog
feeds.description: This blog was founded by Sherri, a stay-at-home mom, in 2014. Its mission is to empower moms to prioritize self-care and cultivate their personal style. The blog features fashion and beauty content, as well as lifestyle tips for moms. The lifestyle blog with a lighthearted mashup of motherhood and stylish practicality; featuring fashion, style & lifestyle trends for moms.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Capone
feeds.description: A mom, teacher & exercise enthusiast (only because I love to eat and drink). Sharing some inspiration and motivation to help you find your happy place.

feeds.title: City Girl Gone Mom
feeds.description: The author of CityGirlGoneMom Danielle Schaffer has a passion for broadcasting and a knack for home design. Danielle guides moms through discovering new and tried-and-true family experiences. CityGirlGoneMom seeks to entertain, educate and inspire those who could use a good laugh, a few parenting tips, and some positive momentum.
